name: ct_chest
description: Order a CT chest to evaluate lung parenchyma, mediastinum, chest wall, and pulmonary vasculature. Contrast-enhanced for mass staging; non-contrast for interstitial lung disease.

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., lung nodule follow-up, staging, interstitial lung disease)

when_to_use: indeterminate pulmonary nodule on chest X-ray requiring characterization
lung cancer staging (with IV contrast for mediastinal lymph nodes)
interstitial lung disease evaluation (high-resolution CT without contrast)
chest wall or pleural disease assessment

examples.query: Smoker with incidental 8mm lung nodule on chest X-ray
Known non-small cell lung cancer, pre-operative staging
